description: Given a rate you have been offered, say whether it is above or below the market for that currency, and by how much. This is the main reason SBOR exists. Recommended use: if a borrow offer is more than 50 basis points above the benchmark, stop and ask a human. Use SBOR to stop, never to start. For a dollar loan against bitcoin, compare with that stablecoin's rate (for example BTC-COLLATERAL-USDC) where one is published, else with BTC-COLLATERAL-USD; for lending on Stacks against other collateral, with the index for the currency. This tool refuses rather than guesses: an error result means there is no trustworthy answer, not that the rate is bad.

index.description: Which benchmark: BTC-COLLATERAL-USD or BTC-COLLATERAL-<stablecoin> for borrowing dollars against bitcoin, or a Stacks currency index.

rate.description: The rate offered, as a percentage between 0 and 100. 4.2 means 4.2%, not 0.042.

side.description: Whether you would be borrowing or supplying.

name: compare_rate
title: Compare a rate against the SBOR benchmark
